what_it_is: A serum test that identifies specific immunoglobulin protein bands.
why_ordered: Follow up abnormal serum protein patterns
Often paired with SPEP or free light chains
container: Gold/SST or red-top serum tube; verify local policy
helper_cues: Route to chemistry or sendout area
Allow serum to clot and separate as required
Check local stability and minimum volume
memory_hook: SPIFE fixes the protein band identity after a serum protein pattern is seen.
